content: <thought>The molecular formula derived from the mass spectrum is C₇H₁₀O₂, which matches the formula obtained from the validated SMILES O=C(O)C1=CCCCC1 (cyclohex‑1‑ene‑1‑carboxylic acid). The IR spectrum shows an O–H stretch (~3500 cm⁻¹) and carbonyl absorptions (1704, 1681 cm⁻¹), consistent with a carboxylic acid containing a C=C bond, exactly as in this structure. The formula and functional‑group evidence align, so this SMILES is the most plausible answer.
